title: Harness^2: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World
abstract: arXiv:2610.14224v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents' capabilities depend not only on their underlying models but also on their execution harnesses. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a promising approach to automatically evolve these harnesses. However, deploying RSI in open-world settings still faces two critical challenges. First, open-world tasks are typically unseen during the harness design phase and novel at test time, leaving no ground-truth verifiers to reliably guide online harness edits. Second, the RSI process remains highly task-specific and fails to generalize to novel scenarios. We introduce Harness^2, a plug-and-play, recursive agent harnessing framework that addresses these challenges through two connected levels of recursion. Task-level recursion refines the current task's harness using a contrastive Propose-Probe-Compose step that reliably guides edits without ground-truth verifiers, and can be scaled further via parallel or sequential recursion. translated_title: Harness²：面向开放世界的递归智能体框架演进
translated_abstract: LLM智能体的能力不仅取决于其底层模型，还取决于其执行框架。递归自我改进（RSI）为自动演化这些框架提供了一种有前景的方法。然而，在开放世界环境中部署RSI仍面临两个关键挑战。首先，开放世界任务通常在框架设计阶段未曾见过，在测试时也是新颖的，因而缺乏真值验证器来可靠地指导在线框架编辑。其次，RSI过程仍然高度任务特定，无法泛化到新颖场景。我们提出了Harness²，一个即插即用的递归智能体框架演进框架，通过两个相互关联的递归层次来解决这些挑战。任务级递归采用对比式的“提议-探测-组合”（Propose-Probe-Compose）步骤来优化当前任务的框架，在没有真值验证器的情况下也能可靠地指导编辑，并且可以通过并行或串行递归进一步扩展。（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出Harness²框架，通过任务级递归（利用无需真值验证器的对比式提议-探测-组合方法优化框架）与框架级递归两层机制，实现智能体执行框架在开放世界中无需人工干预的自动演进与泛化。
en_tdlr: Harness^2 is a plug-and-play recursive agent harnessing framework that employs two connected levels of recursion—task-level recursion using a contrastive Propose-Probe-Compose step to reliably guide harness edits without ground-truth verifiers, and harness-level recursion—to enable automatic harness evolution and generalization in open-world settings.
